वाढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
 1. Much, abundant, exceeding.
 2. Hard, firm.
Adv.
 n. or Ind. (-ढं)
 1. Much, excessive, excessively.
 2. Very well,
well, (assent, promise.)
 3. A particle signifying conclusion, de-
duction.
 E. वह् to take, to bear, aff. क्त; form. irr.

वाढविक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Powerful, very strong, mighty.
 E. वाढ, विक्रम prowess.
